precepts.text: Take heed that no man deceive you: for many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ, and shall deceive many. In Liberia they told us the many is us ten men out there teaching. No: the many that came in his name saying I am Christ is the image the conquistadors carried worldwide.
precepts.point: For the worshipping of idols not to be named is the beginning, the cause, and the end of all evil. The beginning sin with Eve was idolatry, and these end times are going to end the same way.
precepts.why:
Wisdom says that “Whom men could not honour in presence, because they dwelt far off, they took the counterfeit of his visage from far, and made an express image of a king whom they honoured, to the end that by this their forwardness they might flatter him that was absent, as if he were present.” Verse 17 goes with Matthew 24.

“Take heed that no man deceive you. For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.” In Liberia there were ten brethren out there teaching, and they said the many is you. So the many Christ was talking about is ten men with a Bible? You’re stupid as hell.

The white man took the counterfeit of this white man’s image from far, from Rome and Spain, under the conquistadors. Columbus came with a whole wooden cross of Jesus and images of Jesus, and there were thousands of conquistadors who went worldwide. That is the many that came in his name saying I am Christ. He is not talking about ten negroes with a Bible; he is talking about these folks. But our people in Africa do not want to admit that; they feel safer saying it is you than the white man.

The image kept spreading. “The singular diligence of the artificer did help to set forward the ignorant to more superstition”: the artificer is the artist. Leonardo da Vinci made preliminary sketches in the 1400s of Cesare Borgia as the new Jesus. The Head of Christ, the Sallman Head, was painted by Warner Sallman in 1940; the Baptist bookstore popularized it through the southern United States, and the Salvation Army and the YMCA handed out pocket-sized versions to American servicemen heading overseas in World War II. That is how that image became famous.

“And so the multitude, allured by the grace of the work, took him now for a god”. Our people in Christianity truly believe those false images of the white man are Jesus, and the Bible calls them the ignorant. “And this was an occasion to deceive the world”: the idolatry itself is the deceiving of many that Christ warned of, and it started with Nimrod, Semiramis and Tammuz long before Cesare Borgia.

precepts.text: He opened his mouth in blasphemy against God: the white man set himself up as God and went against all God's laws; this is the function of the Roman Catholic Church. It was given unto him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them: Spain and Portugal made war against the saints of God and overcame us in slavery. And power was given him over all kindreds, and tongues, and nations: and all that dwell upon the earth shall worship him.
precepts.point: For the worshipping of idols not to be named is the beginning, the cause, and the end, of all evil. Why does it say beginning? It goes back to Adam and Eve: their sin was idolatry. Christianity is an idolatrous religion.
precepts.why:
Wisdom says “a father afflicted with untimely mourning, when he hath made an image of his child soon taken away, now honoured him as a god”. Pope Alexander VI, Rodrigo Borgia, died on August 18, 1503, before his son Caesar Borgia, who lost his power and was killed in a skirmish in Spain in 1507. But it was the father’s instruction to use his son as white Jesus. Caesar Borgia is the one they set up as Christ. Revelation 13 shows what that beast did.

“And he opened his mouth in blasphemy against God, to blaspheme his name, and his tabernacle, and them that dwell in heaven.” They set themselves up: the white man set himself up as God and went against all God’s laws. This is the creation and function of the Roman Catholic Church.

“And it was given unto him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them”. Spain and Portugal made war against the saints of God, and they overcame us in slavery. “And power was given him over all kindreds, and tongues, and nations”: the white man conquered everybody.

“And all that dwell upon the earth shall worship him, whose names are not written in the book of life of the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world.” Shall worship him, the so-called white man. In The Tale of the Borgia Pope by John Bond, under the bust of the Saviour: it is an open secret that Caesar Borgia, the son of Pope Alexander, had posed for it. So all the world started to worship him as God, the son of God.

That is Wisdom’s “ungodly custom grown strong” that “was kept as a law, and graven images were worshipped by the commandments of kings.” The custom of worshipping the white man as Jesus grew strong in the earth, and his images stand in Brazil, New York, Mexico, you name it: “the counterfeit of his visage”. The worshipping of idols is “the beginning, the cause, and the end, of all evil”; it goes back to Adam and Eve, whose sin was idolatry, and the sin of these last days is the same. Christianity is an idolatrous religion.

precepts.text: Wherefore, my dearly beloved, flee from idolatry.
precepts.point: The worshipping of idols not to be named is the beginning, the cause, and the end of all evil. Idolatry is your stubbornness, your bullheadedness, and your disdain for God's commandments.
precepts.why:
“For the worshipping of idols not to be named is the beginning, the cause, and the end, of all evil.” Understand that idolatry is not only bowing to a statue. Idolatry is going into your stubbornness, your bullheadedness, and your disdain for God’s commandments. Setting your own will above the commandments is the beginning, the cause and the end of all evil.

So Paul gives the answer to it: “Wherefore, my dearly beloved, flee from idolatry.” Do what? Flee from idolatry. Do not stand there and bargain with it; run from it.

This comes as the Lord promises to gather his people: “I will save my people from the east country, and from the west country”, and bring them to dwell in the midst of Jerusalem, “and they shall be my people, and I will be their God, in truth and in righteousness.” The twelve tribes scattered over here until the time of restoration have to flee their idols, their stubbornness and their disdain for the law, to be that people.

precepts.text: Shall the thing formed say to him that formed it, Why hast thou made me thus? Esau is a vessel of wrath fitted to destruction.
precepts.point: That which is made with hands is cursed, as well it as he that made it.
precepts.why:
Wisdom says “that which is made with hands is cursed, as well it, as he that made it: he, because he made it; and it, because, being corruptible, it was called god.” We did not glorify the Lord; we went after vain imaginations, professed ourselves to be wise, made idolatrous images after the image of corruptible man, and then called them god. The thing made and its maker are both cursed.

Now go to Christ, who is also a maker: he made everything seen and unseen, in earth and in heaven. Paul asks, “Nay but, O man, who art thou that repliest against God? Shall the thing formed say to him that formed it, Why hast thou made me thus?” It is a rhetorical question, because everything he made is in its perfect form and perfect order. The hummingbirds still go to the nectar, lions still chase the beasts, mothers still give suck to their young, the whales do not get out of the water to walk on land, and the water does not pass the bounds of the sand unless the Lord sends his angels in the storm. Everything is in perfect order except the twelve tribes of Israel. Keep my commandments that you may live, and we said no.

“Hath not the potter power over the clay, of the same lump to make one vessel unto honour, and another unto dishonour?” Christ created both. Jacob and Esau came from the same mother and father, the same lump: one a vessel of honour, which we descend from, and the other a vessel of dishonour.

Then: “What if God, willing to shew his wrath, and to make his power known, endured with much longsuffering the vessels of wrath fitted to destruction”. While Esau fulfils his role as God’s sword, the Lord lets him do what he was created for, and what he was created for is destruction. They are here to serve a purpose, and then the Lord is going to destroy them. Wipe your tears: the nations got to go.

So the war of the gods is this: the true Maker whose works stay in order, against the gods men make with hands, which are cursed with the men who made them.

precepts.why:
Why does the Most High speak of a wife playing the harlot when Israel's sin was abominations? Because “the devising of idols was the beginning of spiritual fornication, and the invention of them the corruption of life.”

Idolatry is spiritual fornication, which is why the Most High uses the marriage analogy for Israel. The abominations Israel must put away out of his sight are the idols, and to serve them is to play the harlot against him. Put them away, swear that the Lord liveth in truth, in judgment and in righteousness, and the nations shall bless themselves in him; as long as we follow him, we do not have to worry about the nations coming against us.
